scope: single-Mac real-window loopback; not remote Ponte
limits: 40-second isolated same-Mac tests, not remote network acceptance.
Trace-on/off order off,on,on,off; CPU is whole test process.
Frames decoded/render callbacks are not physical display time.
Faults affect outbound host RTP only; no RTCP/DTLS/probe impairment.
Loss counters are primary RTP sequence loss; RTX recovery is separate.
